item.title: A look at potential landing spots and trade values for Maxx Crosby
item.description: There will be many teams speaking to the Raiders at the scouting combine in Indianapolis about the availability of Maxx Crosby and what it might take to get him.

item.title: Suspect in Las Vegas Tesla fires pleads guilty to all federal charges without plea deal
item.description: Paul Kim faces between five and 70 years in prison after a Las Vegas judge accepted his plea deal for setting multiple Teslas on fire last year.

item.title: UNLV’s Dan Mullen returns to Florida, receives Coach of the Year honor
item.description: UNLV football coach Dan Mullen was presented with the Steve Spurrier First-Year Coach of the Year award Monday in Gainesville, Florida.

item.title: Nevada congressional members attending, boycotting Trump’s State of the Union
item.description: Four Nevada congressional members confirmed they will attend President Donald Trump’s State of the Union address Tuesday, while one congresswoman said she was boycotting it.

item.title: Andersson, Hertl return to Knights after Olympic experience
item.description: Golden Knights defenseman Rasmus Andersson didn’t want to comment on his personal experience representing Sweden in the Winter Olympics. He was a healthy scratch twice.
